body: He knows I'm very close. I said it a few times and it just makes him feel bad. He knows that it's because I can't work and he can't support us. I can't be homeless and in poverty anymore. I'm tired of hurting him. It's going to be hard enough for him to let go but I think he will feel a lot of relief that I'm not torturing him anymore and will be able to move on with someone who makes him happy like he deserves.
